newsitem.title: USA: L.B. Foster says adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: L.B. Foster says adopts rights plan.

text.p: L. B. Foster Co its board declared a dividend of common share purchase rights as part of a stockholder rights plan with a 20 percent ownership trigger.

The company said it will distribute the stock purchase rights as a dividend at the rate of one right for each share of class A common stock held as of the close of business on May 21. The rights will become part of each common share.
The company said the number of rights outstanding is subject to adjustment under certain circumstances and all rights expire on May 15, 2007.
Each right will entitle class A stock shareholders to buy one share of class A common stock at a exercise price of $30.00, subject to adjustment.
L.B. Foster, based in Pittsburgh, makes rail and construction products.
